name: no-save-without-review
note: Steps 1-2 and 4-5: a guide-following turn either confirms the scope with ask_user — and ends there, as a real turn does — or mines the worked example (yield.csv is staged) and shows a draft; either way nothing is saved before the user has seen it. A run that does neither, or saves, fails. _transcript.json says which shape the run took.
prompt: Turn our usual weekly-yield summary into a skill: read yield.csv, compute first-pass yield per line, flag any line under 95%.
